purpose: Document first-party local registry/viewer evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Fetched official cadastral-info viewer and its static JavaScript/config. The code requests WFS 1.1.0 GETFEATURE for layer LSMD_CONT_LDREG, with one feature and CQL PNU equality; its output is read as GeoJSON geometry. The configured public route https://gis.daejeon.go.kr/o2map/services/wfs returned HTTP 404 for both GetCapabilities and a one-feature bounded locator query. No PNU was used and no geometry was retained. Whether the portal’s internal O2Map WFS route is available only through viewer-side routing or a separate service host, and whether a parcel covers the WUP point. No citywide coverage test was made.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Daejeon Metropolitan City Spatial Information Portal; exposes dedicated real-estate and cadastral-information search.
Official service description: location/address search and parcel-related real-estate information connected to cadastral maps.
Official cadastral-information search viewer page and published scripts.
Official viewer JavaScript uses the LSMD_CONT_LDREG WFS feature type and filters by PNU for a one-feature cadastral parcel response.
Official viewer config defines relative WFS route `o2map/services/wfs`.

attempts.result: HTTP 200; script uses WFS 1.1.0 GETFEATURE, type LSMD_CONT_LDREG, one feature and CQL PNU equality; geometry read from GeoJSON.
HTTP 404; no features or geometry returned; query was bounded to a small envelope near the WUP locator and did not request properties.
